notes.title: 🛠️ Highway Police Simulator | Update 1.0.6 Live Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Officers,

It’s with great pleasure and pride that we present Update 1.0.6 for Highway Police Simulator. Over the past few weeks, we’ve worked hard to deliver a substantial update with 131 individual improvements, focusing on performance, missions, and overall game stability.

Below you'll find a full breakdown, including some key highlights and a complete changelog.

[b]🚨 Mission Improvements (38 in total)[/b]
• Mission objective icons now indicate special requirements (e.g., specific vehicle needed)
• New randomized search zone positions in A Glimpse at Terror
• Improved navigation marker logic and visual placement in various missions
• Fixed issues with:
  • Incorrect or missing objective markers
  • Dialogue sequences not triggering
  • Missions not progressing properly
  • Game state not saving after completing missions
• Re-enabled “From Russia With Love” mission and fixed related crashes
• Fixed missing NPCs and missing banter in multiple story missions
• Tweaked mission reward balancing and logic
• Improved logic for partner behavior and detection in scripted sequences

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/2b4ff6fb39b0a3abc24baf49f25904a050e116a6.jpg[/img]
[b]
💬 Dialogue & Partner Interactions[/b]
• Dialogue flow improved when multiple conversations trigger in sequence
• Banter now pauses correctly when menus are opened
• Fixed issues with dialogue cameras, choice menus, and missing dialogue options
• Fixed Nataly freezing when trying to walk down stairs (e.g., From Russia With Love)
• Banter no longer interrupts during active shootouts

[b]🚗 Vehicles[/b]
• Added new visual smoke effect for broken engines – helps visualize engine failures 🔧 (Consider adding an image!)
• Fixed DUI test dialogues not appearing when required
• Fixed issue with light dialog triggering incorrectly
• Adjusted vehicle physics and spawn behavior during fast travel
• Fixed rare cases of firetruck behavior breaking or clipping into geometry
• Fixed vehicles behaving incorrectly when opening menus while driving

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/2a0811cd5b8efcf319bc059e5a22aa1d6a6cdc38.png[/img]

[b]⚙️ Performance & Optimization (29 in total)[/b]
• Major improvements to core systems (animations, save/load logic, UI rendering)
• Reduced lag when:
  • Driving around large areas
  • Unlocking fast travel points
  • Discovering points of interest
  • Completing mission objectives
• Improved performance baseline around police station
• Reduced stuttering when loading NPCs and other characters
• Improved animation handling (e.g., shotgun reload, time-skipping sequence)
• Dropped objects now properly despawn when fast traveling
• Faster menu navigation and reduced memory consumption

💡 Note: We’re already working on more performance updates to further reduce frame spikes and stutters in the next patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/b7880cf86c45660ca23fa67f5f3cb5a09e002274.jpg[/img]

[b]🧍‍♂️ Characters & Animations[/b]
• Player now properly holds coffee cup during time skip scene ☕
• Fixed A-posing and character loading glitches
• Improved facial animations and posture alignment
• Improved reload animation for the shotgun

[b]🔫 Combat[/b]
• Bullet impacts now have custom sounds when hitting vehicles
• Improved AI pathing during shootouts
• Partner (Nataly) now auto-revives if downed
• Fixed crash when partner is revived by medic
• Fixed hit registration on enemies – especially those affected by land mines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/7c5906c8226208abf1d8664cdd6880c7b13ca0d6.jpg[/img]

[b]🧑‍💻 User Interface (UI) – 10 Improvements[/b]
• Scaled UI properly for high-DPI displays
• Improved responsiveness of the radial menu
• Fixed issues with:
  • Missing or delayed mission markers
  • Inaccurate tech tree vehicle unlocks
  • Wrong vehicle preview and descriptions in tech tree
  • Drone UI displaying incorrect controls or icons
  • Visual glitches on vending machines
• Map now properly draws discovered points of interest

[b]🌍 World, Environment & Systems[/b]
• Improved player respawn logic – no more stuck positions on reload
• Fixed terrain collision and lighting inconsistencies
• World boundaries now enforced more reliably
• Adjusted spawn logic for NPCs and static objects
• Improved trigger logic for enterable areas (e.g., police station, mission zones)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/935869b53153f52304ebc366f9176e9ea90e8c23.jpg[/img]

[b]
✅ In Summary[/b]
• 🎯 131 total improvements
• 🛠️ Focus on performance, mission flow, and player experience
• 🚀 Reduced lag, faster menus, smoother driving
• 👮 Better mission clarity, UI scaling, and combat behavior

We hope this update makes your shift on the Autobahn smoother and more immersive than ever.
Thank you for your continued support – and keep that feedback coming!

To serve and protect,
— Your HWPS Team at Z-Software 🚓

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Live Now!
notes.notes:
🚓 Patch Notes – New Update is Here! 🚓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/ffc026942c21bf3b47e417f5feed30e17b1cb28e.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We've got a brand-new update for you! This patch brings numerous improvements, bug fixes, and optimizations to make your experience even smoother. Here are the key changes:

[b]🏎️ Vehicles[/b]

[*]Vehicles no longer shine excessively bright in tunnels.
[*]Cars in parking lots now spawn correctly and no longer on top of each other.
[*]Fast traveling to "Hospital Apoloya" will no longer cause vehicles to clip into the ground.

[b]🤖 AI & Interactions[/b]

[*]NPCs will no longer block each other due to faulty interaction locations.
[*]Dialogue options with drivers are now always correctly initialized.
[*]The "Talk" action is no longer arbitrarily replaced by mission titles.
[*]Vending machines no longer break all interactions after dispensing an item.

[b]🎯 Missions & Story[/b]

[*]Fixed various mission-related issues, including:
[*]"Catching the Dragon": Bobby can no longer be arrested without providing evidence.
[*]"Ambush on the Delivery": Officer Tim is no longer "alive" after dying in a shootout.
[*]"Blown Cover": Proper camera focus in dialogues and correct mission marker for reporting.
[*]"It's Getting Personal": Alfred is no longer mistakenly mentioned in dialogues.
[*]"The Prisoners' Escort": Lucia now walks properly instead of crouching toward Jameson.

[b]🔫 Shooting & Combat[/b]

[*]Aiming now responds immediately without delay.
[*]The crosshair resets correctly after dying while crouching.
[*]Reloading now works even if the clip is full (without upgrades).
[*]Reinforcements no longer disappear suddenly during shootouts.
[*]Dead enemies stay dead – no more standing up after being defeated.

[b]🚦 Traffic Stops[/b]

[*]Added a return option to the "Tests" section in driver dialogues.
[*]Items in the trunk can now be picked up for investigation on the first button press.
[*]The pause menu can no longer be accidentally opened in observation mode.

[b]🎮 Optimizations & Performance[/b]

[*]Reduced NPC vehicle count to improve performance and prevent excessive traffic jams.
[*]Optimized player position check to ensure they are standing on solid ground.
[*]Reduced sky update frequency to improve performance.
[*]Stability improvements for restoring story progress from savegames.

[b]🖥️ UI & Quality of Life[/b]

[*]Improved map navigation: A selection wheel now appears when multiple icons are close together.
[*]Mission and HUD objectives now indicate whether they have failed.
[*]Fixed the "Keen Eye" icon scaling in the action menu.
[*]Accident sketch background now properly aligned.
[*]Virtual cursor now correctly sized on high-DPI displays.

🎉 Thank you for your feedback and support! Enjoy the update, and as always, let us know if you encounter any further issues!

Your dev team 🚔

notes.title: Highway Police Simulator | Update 1.0.3. Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/35a0e7288725739b4fff2b5912a93841fc6700b8.jpg[/img]

The new [i]Highway Police Simulator[/i] update is here and it brings many improvements! 

From numerous gameplay bug fixes to optimized environments and new equipment like flashlights and tasers, there is a lot to discover. 

There is also a 10% discount on [i]Highway Police Simulator[/i] for one week from today.

Read the full changelog here:

[h1][b]Gameplay & Missions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] A Meeting with Terror: 
[list]
[*] Travis' car does not appear anymore in the spots the player needs to check.[/list]
[*] Aftermath: 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Rush Angel did not spawn and could not be raced against.
[*] Rush Angel race can only take place at night now.
[*] Fixed a issue with loading into the mission re-triggering a dialogue.[/list]
[*] Ambush on the Delivery: 
[list]
[*] Fast traveling is no longer possible when having to drive to the rest stop under time pressure.[/list]
[*] At the End of it All:
[list]
[*] Removed clone of the Chief from cutscene.
[*] Added an additional cutscene.
[*] Fixed a situation where Nataly will talk via radio while standing next to Marsh.[/list]
[*] Live Action Heist:
[list]
[*] Dead guy is no longer moving.
[*] Fixed a bug where an injured criminal would not be shown correctly during dialogue.
[*] Fixed issue with being stuck with a gun when loading into the mission.
[*] Fixed issue with blocked main progression when the main character dies and leaves the location afterwards.[/list]
[*] In Search for Clues: 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with writing reports no longer possible after repairing the vehicle.[/list]
[*] Smiley: 
[list]
[*] Towed car no longer has engine running and radio on.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nataly would end up on the roof of the police station after dialogues.[/list]
[*] The Distraught Farmer: 
[list]
[*] Improved the explanations and directions the game provides.[/list]
[*] Up Above: 
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with mission not loading correctly from savegame.[/list]
[*] Your Everyday Race Track:
[list]
[*] Nataly will no longer be stranded on the race track.[/list]
[*] The Game Begins: 
[list]
[*] The evidence image "Rug" now correctly shows a rug again instead of a door lock.
[/list]
[*] Shootout Calls:
[list]
[*] Aborting the mission will clear up enemies correctly now.[/list]
[*]Accidents: 
[list]
[*] Improvements were made to positioning of debris, evidence, etc.
[*] Fixed a bug where the accident sketch would extend beyond the frame of the police PC. 
[*] NPCs will no longer be on the phone while talking to the player.
[*] Increased variability of selected spawn points for procedural accident missions.
[*] Improved item spawning in procedural accident missions, resulting in better distribution along the road.[/list]
[*] Tutorials: 
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial about the morality system.[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where an NPC could not be arrested and police backup would not arrive.
[/list]
[h1][b]Performance & Stability[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Consoles: Fixed an issue that could cause crashes when starting the application.
[*] PS5: Fixed a bug that caused area-of-responsibility restrictions to incorrectly assume the main character was outside the area.
[*] Fixed a bug where purchased upgrades would not get saved after closing the game.
[*] Fast Travel:
[list]
[*] Going to Qaluuk Hospital no longer causes infinite loading screens or a damaged vehicle.
[*] Fixed a cause for infinite loading screens when going to Apoloya Hospital.[/list]
[*] Optimization:
[list]
[*] Improved loading of character portrait images, which no longer cause a lag now.
[*] Reduced hitches when characters play back fixed animations.
[*] Improved several animations.
[*] Non-accepted radio calls will no longer cause a "mission failed" notification.
[*] Reloading at Glasshouse no longer spawns player under the map.[/list]
[*] Savegames: Improved reliability of restoring checkpoints in missions.[/list]
[h1][b]Environment & World[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added pedestrians.
[*] Added set dressing to a shootout location.
[*] Added trailers on some rest stops and parking lots.
[*] Adjusted some positions of donut vendors to better fitting locations.
[*] Challenge board is now lit up at night.
[*] Corrected advertisement signage at some gas stations.
[*] Fixed some display issues with direction signage.
[*] Evidence on the whiteboard in the station is now fixed by magnets.
[*] Fixed a flickering wall element in the basement of the police station.
[*] Fixed placement of some fire hydrants.
[*] Grass no longer grows on parking lots in Meris Hill.
[*] Guiderail posts will now cast shadows.
[*] Improved decoration of Meris Hill.
[*] Improved the transition from roads to the ground.
[*] Small vegetation like grass (meadows) and shrubs (desert) has been added on PS5 and Xbox Series X. 
[*] Improved vegetation fidelity on PS5 and Xbox Series X to be on par with the PC experience.
[*] The driveway gate at the station is opening earlier now.
[*] Improved runtime cost of ambient soundscape.
[*] Fixed errors with textures for environmental assets like stones and haybales.
[*]Police PC: 
[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping buttons on toolbar.
[*] People in database are no longer only born in September.
[*] People no longer own prison buses.[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]Vehicles & Traffic[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Roads: Fixed patches of missing road geometry 
[*] Broken Down Vehicles:
[list]
[*] Appear in correctly varying colors again.
[*] A sick driver will now give the correct amount of points.
[*] Cars now spawn correctly while driving with the motorcycle.[/list]
[*] Fire Truck: Fixed the positioning of brake discs.
[*] Motorcycle: Fixed shaking of camera while driving.
[*] Helicopter: 
[list]
[*] Tweaked speed.
[*] Fixed a bug where helicopter missions could not be accepted/were accepted automatically.[/list]
[*] Traffic: Fixed a crash that could happen randomly, especially when using fast travel.
[*] Racing challenges: Fixed a bug where the camera would freeze after completing a racing challenge. 
[*] Fixed a visual bug with the hood of NPC vehicles during engine inspections.
[*] Vehicles:
[list]
[*] Added drivers.
[*] Added more bluelight sequences to select from.
[*] Grant Bulls in parking lots now have license plates.
[*] Improved logic when trying to exit a car that has its doors blocked.
[*] License plate lights are no longer permanently on.
[*] License plates do not read "default" anymore.
[*] Regular traffic now stops correctly for the player and the player vehicle.
[*] The Apello Triumph pick-up truck has been added to the game and is now driving on the streets of Caminora.
[*] Vehicle damage no longer prevents entering the vehicle.
[*] Vehicles cannot shine brightly in tunnels anymore.
[*] Vehicles will not get teleported off the highway anymore when driving close to guard rails. 
[*] Fixed a situation where the driver character could become invisible when rotating the camera at the right moment.
[*] Fixed an issue which could lead the vehicle to suddenly stop moving if you drive really fast into a city.[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]Tools, Weapons & Combat[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] A flashlight has been added for the player and Nataly 
[*] New sound for new animation of shotgun reload.
[*] Fixed a situation where the camera, while aiming and falling, would glitch into the main character.
[*] Shooting Challenges: 
[list]
[*] Two new challenges have been added, available at the training facility opposite the police station.
[*] Stationary targets are no longer called enemies.[/list]
[*] Shootouts:
[list]
[*] Dead enemies no longer try to shoot.
[*] Added police reinforcements at the end of shootouts.
[*] Reinforcements have individual names now.
[*] Targets are counted visually in the mission description for shooting missions again.[/list]
[*] Taser:
[list]
[*] Taser has been added as an additional equippable weapon, unlockable through the tech tree.
[*] Added non-lethal "Takedown" popup hint when taking out an enemy.[/list]
[*] Weapons: Crosshair will now indicate whether the target is in weapon range.[/list]
[h1][b]Characters & AI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Characters do not flicker anymore during the arrest sequence in the police station basement.
[*] Characters are better positioned during dialogues.
[*] English & German lip synchronization works consistently now.
[*] Fixed the positioning of Rush Angels piercings. 
[*] Improved performance of clothing materials. 
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the eyes of the player and Nataly were visible too sharply through vehicles windshields. 
[*] NPC AI:
[list]
[*] Improved NPC behavior during dialogues.
[*] NPCs can now open and close doors on their own.
[*] NPCs do not get stuck in the DUI test animations anymore.[/list]
[*] Partner Nataly:
[list]
[*] Nataly is aiming properly now.
[*] She no longer jumps at the start of conversations.
[*] She now gets back to her feet on her own after critical situations.
[*] She now holds her gun correctly while shooting.
[*] She will now be avoided by traffic.
[*] Her hair no longer clips through the helicopter uniform helmet.[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]UI & Controls[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the wardrobe clothing menu by simplifying the menu options from 3 to only 2.
[*] Increased the options to pause or end dialogues with NPCs at any point.
[*] Fixed incorrect camera behavior when switching from first to third person perspective.
[*] Map:
[list]
[*] Added legend to the map.
[*] Changed behavior of map markers for missions.
[*] Now easier to select markers which are near each other.
[*] GPS navigation on the map is only shown until reaching the threshold of a search area.
[*] Added overlay of morality status for areas on the large map 
[*] Fixed several usability issues with pathing in the maps 
[*] Now allows selecting which specific objective to follow for navigation.
[*] Now shows objective information when hovering over a target.[/list]
[*] UI Improvements:
[list]
[*] Added button for toggling morality overlay.
[*] Improved character customization screen.
[*] Improved radial menu usability.
[*] Improved the usability of the garage menu by e.g. simplifying options, separating the tech tree from vehicles and reworking their inspection feature.
[*] UI now properly switches state when delivering an arrested driver to the station.
[*] When choosing response options in dialogues the list no longer moves around when playing with mouse.
[*] Improved Minimap UI North Icon for rotating Minimap.
[*] Fixed Garries name in dialogues, as it was shown incorrectly 
[*] Fixed a bug where the amount of collected donuts was not displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed typo in notification when player tries to enter a helicopter in wrong clothes.[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Roadmap | Upcoming Updates and Improvements
notes.notes:
Now that you can spend your first hours in [i]Highway Police Simulator[/i], we are happy to present you the first steps of our roadmap! From now on, we will be working on regular patches and updates that will constantly improve your gaming experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/975d4a8cc8f7ed945523c4710c14eac5d555aeae.jpg[/img]

Here is an overview of the upcoming updates:


[b]Update 1.1 - Expected to be available on December 15, 2024[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Gameplay News: Illegal Items | Dev-Blog#18
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

Today we want to show you some of the gameplay stuff. These are some suspicious objects that can be found within the game. „Suspicious object“ is an important clue when investigating accidents and conducting traffic stops. In the following, we will describe more: Please do not forget to wishlist the game! 

Finding alcoholic beverages, especially empty ones, should be an indicator that the assumed owner may be intoxicated. In accidents as well as traffic stops, this is a strong clue to perform a field sobriety test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/34e06550b88b9da721cdee7b7b919697d8871adf.jpg[/img]

Finding a firearm is not neccessarily dangerous - the owner may be aggressive, but the weapon may as well be registered and totally legal to carry. It’s your job to check that the weapon isn’t from an illegal source and carries a serial number. It is also important to check that the owner has the right permits. Checking the police record of the owner will also give you important clues if there may be any illegal activity going on! And always be on the lookout, as when there is one firearm, there might be more… You better not get caught in a shootout in the middle of the street!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/d696d81a2607ce2077c64007fde95cc573d98bb8.jpg[/img]

Finding narcotics on a driver, in a vehicle, or near an accident scene should always be an indicator that the assumed owner may either be involved in criminal activities or was driving under the influence of them. Narcotics are illegal to carry though, so an arrest may be necessary! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/dce9e93e701bc7daa06d4df26093ccfeaf4939c3.jpg[/img]

That concludes our little excursion into illegal items. Did we miss anything? What would you like to see as well? On another note, we’ve also been at the PAX West in Seattle last weekend. Many thanks to everyone who stopped by to take a look at the demo, and especially all the nice feedback that we got from you!

notes.title: Police car sounds | Dev-Blog#9
notes.notes:
Greetings, law enforcers!👮‍♂️ 👮‍♀️ 

[previewyoutube=U7H0Gi_EKLY;full][/previewyoutube]

Have you ever wondered, why the police car has various sounds, when its sirens are on? Why not just use one? Previously we've shown different bluelight modes and now it's time to make this topic complete with the description of the available siren sound types.🚨 🎶

Patrol officers has a ton of equipment inside their vehicles and part of that is the emergency equipment in order to respond to emergencies. The sound, a siren, is an audible sound, coming from that vehicle to warn people around: hey, we're coming through, please yield right away!

The three main sirens we're talking about is the Wail, the Yelp and the Phaser (or Piercer). 

The first one, the Wail, is the most routine one that we hear. You hear it on fire trucks and ambulances and described as a "wee-woo" sound — a high and a low, that's elongated in length. Then the Yelp, that is the same "wee-woo" sound, but in a faster frequency. So that when you're approaching traffic after that Wail, you can get people's attention. 

And then that Phaser sound, almost sounding like a phaser gun. This is from like spaceship kind of sounding stuff. This is what officers call "a traffic intersection clearer". So as you've had that other stuff on, you're approaching, you want to change up that audible sound to get other drivers attention. You get that, you clear the intersection and it's back to the Wail. 

If the lights are on but there is no siren, it could be that there is an ongoing crime and officers do not yet wish to alert the perpetrator of their presence. Another possibility is that, though an officer is headed to an emergency, there is no traffic on the road that needs to move out of the way 🚔 

Check out the video and hear the difference 🔊 

Stay on the alert and remember, that everything happens for a reason.

notes.title: Traffic stops and accidents | Dev-Blog#2
notes.notes:
👮‍♀️ Hello officers,👮‍♂️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931043/0f920149b971aff66b8d032a46314888bef5cb93.png[/img]

This is our second dev-blog#2
👉[url=https://discord.com/channels/1216704380422586448/1229781227561680966/1233454238990864484]Discord[/url]


Everyone of you is probably wondering what we are currently working on. Well, actually it's quite simple --> finishing the game 😀 
 
But okay, I understand you want details 😛 
 
We spent the last two weeks mainly focusing on traffic stops and accidents. The shooting also got our special attention. The team is making good progress and discovered interesting aspects that we could add to our existing ideas.
 
🚦 Traffic Stops - Highway Police Simulator🚦 
The goal of traffic stops is to investigate a possible/known crime or minor violation of law by conducting various checks on the stopped vehicle, driver and/or passengers.
 
🚓 Accidents - Highway Police Simulator🚓 
Players responding to accidents will be in charge of managing and investigating the scene by securing traffic, talking to the involved, documenting the accident, gathering evidence, giving out tickets, and finally, drawing a conclusion about the cause of the accident by interpreting all the previously obtained information.
 
🔫 Shooting Feature(Sneak) - Highway Police Simulator🔫 
Yes, there will be the use of weapons in HWPS, as an officer you will have different possibilities to train your skills with the weapon to be prepared for an emergency.
 
Enough writing, now it's YOUR 🫵 turn. Ask your questions and we will answer them as best we can.
 
🫡 Dismissed!🫡
